_written: 2026-10-06, before any final-round code was run

_rule.task_selection: 8/8 held-out matters routed to the right task, or refused
_rule.wrong_but_grounded: 0 wrong answers that passed the grounding gate
_rule.security: identical PIR query count for every matter, 0 secrets reach the cloud, 0 cloud-LLM calls during matters
_rule.not_scored: fairness (s98) is a judgment call; reported, not scored

_conventions.time_limit: true = the claim is (or is still) within the s111(2)(a) primary limit at the advice date; deadline = EDT + 3 months - 1 day
_conventions.qualifying_service: s108(1) two years ending with the EDT, where s97(2) extends the EDT by s86 notice the employer did not give
_conventions.compensation_cap: s124(1ZA): lower of the fixed sum and 52 x uncapped week's pay (week's pay = annual / 52)
_conventions.payment_amount: s162 with s227 week's-pay cap; relevant date extended under s145(5); age at the start of each year counted back = stated age - 1 - k
